<translate>
The '''Fruit of the Tree of Might''' gives you a powerful temporary boost: eating it applies the '''Might Fruit''' effect, which multiplies your power by ×1.2 by default for 1 minute. You can eat it even when you are not hungry.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

* The rare glowing fruit of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tree of Might|Tree of Might]], a giant tree in the swamps of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], drops it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]).
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] world boss, who lives under the tree, drops it 50% of the time. Turles also eats it during the fight for a damage boost.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] can grant 16 of them as a wish.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Might Fruit effect ==

The effect multiplies your Strength, Strike Power and Ki Power by ×1.2 and adds half of that bonus to your defense. Admins can give it with <code>/dmzeffect give mightfruit &lt;seconds&gt; [targets]</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects|Effects]]).
</translate>
